Detailed Definition: Define revenue per share as quarterly revenue (revtq) divided by quarterly common shares outstanding (cshprq). RevenueSurprise is the 4-quarter change in revenue per share minus the average 4-quarter change in revenue per share over the previous 2 years. RevenueSurprise is scaled by its standard deviation over the previous 2 years. Exclude if price less than 5.
